critique: The note proves matched logarithmic covariance and whole-fiber Hausdorff rates only on the fixed three-variable exponent-two subclass; over the broader Sanjaroonpouri--Ramazi class it proves lower bounds alone, as the framing correctly acknowledges. The causal interpretation remains confined to laws satisfying the explicit greatest-Gaussian-divisor condition and known raywise Fourier envelopes and exponents, so this is not general mixed-noise inference. The motivating pcalg and yeast workflow is not implemented or empirically demonstrated, which limits the significance case for a leading econometrics journal. The Parseval identity is used as a leaf lemma without proof or a precise citation; although classical, the note should cite an exact Plancherel/Parseval result covering the stated convention.
